summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a news release reporting its second quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The release details gold production of 188,100 ounces, revenues of $856.9 million, average realized gold price of $4,384 per ounce, net earnings of $230.5 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $507.3 million. It discusses operational improvements at Côté Gold, guidance for the year, and shareholder returns through buybacks. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
